messages:
Priya: quick thread - thinking about an "entropy-aware" auto-fallback mode for rollouts. instead of only looking at error% or latency, we measure response entropy collapse as a signal to degrade. low entropy often correlates with hallucination/repetition. want UX + audit thoughts.
Tom: neat. how do we compute entropy cheaply? rolling token-diversity sketch + a tiny ngram perplexity estimate maybe? :thinking: 
Priya: yeah, token-diversity (unique tokens / total) in a sliding window + an approximate perplexity from a cached ngram sampler. we can sample 1/1000 requests to keep cpu low.
Evan: ops concern: whatever reason we log must be actionable. reason codes like `entropy_low_v1` + confidence float. otherwise customers will ask for explanations.
Priya: UX idea: rollout card shows small signal badges: latency / error / entropy. hover -> value + short definition. click -> compact audit row: ts, routed_pct, primary_signal, est_cost_delta. expand on demand.
Tom: compact audit row should be one-line CSV-friendly. expand for full trace. sampling: propose two-tier sampling: 0.01% full-trace, 1% compact-audit, and event-triggered full-trace when signal delta > threshold.
Evan: also need billing attribution in logs: orig_route, final_route, tokens_consumed. put those into billing export.
Priya: operator controls: one-click freeze (halt auto-routing), quick revert (replay last 10s routing decisions), and a "why" helper that runs on sampled trace and returns top-3 signals in plain english.
infra-bot: reminder: add any new signal to metric catalog with SLOs and cardinality limits. open infra/metrics-987.
Tom: API sketch for rollout config: 
```json
{
  "id":"r_entropy_01",
  "mode":"entropy_aware",
  "signals":["latency_95","error_rate","token_diversity"],
  "actions":{
     "probabilistic":true,
     "hard_escalate":{
        "window":"60s",
        "threshold":0.25
     }
  },
  "sampling":{
     "compact_audit_rate":0.01,
     "full_trace_rate":0.0001,
     "anomaly_boost":10
  }
}
```
Evan: legal wants a readable export for audits. propose sampled NL lines like: "Auto-routed 12% to alt-model due to token_diversity=0.02 (low) + latency spike". generate only for sampled rows.
Priya: agreed. keep NL generator serverless and cached. retention configurable per-account.
Tom: UI needs cost-preview before enabling: show 24h observed vs projected monthly delta for median/95th percentiles. ops sign-off required.
deploy-bot: will post weekly digest of rollouts in entropy-aware mode to #eng-platform. digest includes top reasons + cost delta. :robot_face: 
Evan: next step - Priya, please draft a short RFC (api + ui + telemetry) and include metric budget. i'll route it to infra + security.
Priya: will do, tagging Tom and Evan. thanks all.
